summary: VeriSign filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to offer senior notes due 20XX. The registrant is the issuer offering unsecured senior notes; terms (principal amount, interest rate, maturity) are TBD. Notes will rank equally with existing unsecured debt, not guaranteed by subsidiaries, and redeemable prior to maturity at specified prices. A change-of-control repurchase offer at 101% applies. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, activist, etc.) is involved; this is a routine debt capital markets offering.
